programme.title: God is Mobilizing His Army Now!
programme.desc: Skywatch TV The modern Church is under attack — not from the outside but from within False doctrines twisted theologies and spiritual deception have quietly crept into congregations around the world leaving believers unprepared for the greatest spiritual battle in human history In this powerful series we sit down with Dr Michael K Lake — bestselling author speaker and biblical scholar An internationally recognized authority on dynamic Christian living spiritual warfare the Hebraic Heritage of the Church and end-times prophecy Dr Lakes deep scriptural research is changing the way believers understand the world around them His time serving as a Vietnam War Veteran forged in him a warriors discernment and that same battle-tested perspective now fuels a message that is raw compelling and impossible to ignore Dr Lake pulls back the curtain on the ancient forces driving the rise of church heresy — an agenda stretching back to the plains of Shinar and the dark ambitions of Nimrod himself The Enemy knows that a weaponless Church is no threat to his end-time plans and todays modernized theologies have left too many believers spiritually unprepared and unable to recognize the deception unfolding all around them But this series is not just a warning — it is a battle cry Heaven is raising up a Remnant and Dr Lakes message will inspire challenge and equip you to answer that call

programme.title: Fireborn Ministries - Living UnAnxious-Reclaiming Your Peace with Gabriel Andreson
programme.desc: Anxiety doesn’t knock It walks in takes a seat and dares you to pretend it’s not there It does not care how capable you appear or how much responsibility you carry Anxiety quietly steals focus sleep and clarity often from people who look strong on the outside but feel worn down on the inside If that feels familiar you are not alone More than 40 million adults in the United States struggle with anxiety each year Millions of Christians quietly carry this burden as well wondering how faith fits into panic attacks stress and emotional trials In UnAnxious entrepreneur and business leader Gabriel Andreson shares his journey through burnout and rebuilding his inner life At one point the pressure threatened his health his leadership and the life he had worked so hard to build Raised by parents who pastored in the Vineyard movement he grew up immersed in faith yet still found himself overwhelmed at the height of responsibility His story is not about faith failing but about faith being refined under pressure For more information go to firebornministriescom
